description: Minute-by-minute written commentary for a match, plus the goals, cards and substitutions in order. Useful while a match is in play, and afterwards to see how it unfolded.

events_only.description: true: only goals, cards and substitutions, skipping the running commentary. Default: false

format.description: text (default): compact summary with IDs and links. json: the raw data feed, minified and capped at 60,000 characters

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

limit.description: Maximum ticker entries, most recent last. Default: 60, maximum 300

match_id.description: Match id from get_live_scores, get_day_fixtures or search

name: get_match_commentary

events.description: Goals, cards and substitutions in order

ticker.description: Minute-by-minute written commentary, when the competition has it
